fields.name: density
fields.rationale: The density of the mortar is a critical property that affects its structural performance and application suitability.

fields.name: compressive_strength
fields.rationale: Compressive strength is a key performance indicator for masonry mortars, determining their load-bearing capacity.
evidence: Compressive strength according to EN 1015-11 at least M10

fields.name: thermal_conductivity
fields.rationale: Thermal conductivity is important for understanding the insulation properties of the mortar.
evidence: Thermal conductivity according to EN 1745 lambda10,dry,mat / P = 50 % ≥ 0.29 W/(mK)
Thermal conductivity according to EN 1745 lambda10,dry,mat / P = 90 % ≥ 0.32 W/(mK)

fields.name: mortar_type
fields.rationale: The type of mortar (e.g., thin-bed, special properties) affects its application and performance characteristics.
evidence: thin-bed mortar for the production of masonry
inference_basis: Mention of thin-bed and special properties mortar types

fields.name: water_vapour_permeability
fields.rationale: Water vapour permeability is crucial for assessing the breathability of the mortar, affecting moisture management in structures.
evidence: Water vapour permeability according to EN 1015-19: 15/35
